Clear square pixel clusters, three or four shades per color, readable at native size, no anti-aliased blur, no glow, no background, no tile or ground, absolutely no stones, no surrounding tile, no colored rectangle, no scenery, no letters or UI, no motion trails, no sprite sheet.
